races.verdict: This is wide open and it could pay to side with NELSON MUNTZ who returns from a break off a handy-looking mark and is taken to gain an overdue success at the chief expense of Downpatrick runner-up Dairy Force . Vaureal can also play a prominent role back in this sphere after a chasing victory at Punchestown. Max Meridius completes the shortlist back over a shorter trip. NELSON MUNTZ (IRE) DAIRY FORCE (IRE) VAUREAL (FR)

races.verdict: GONE IN SIXTY isn't an obvious follow-up candidate given his record but with Sean Bowen retaining the ride, he's worth chancing to defy a 5 lb higher mark for his Stratford success.
